q: At the classroom, both Omar, the manager, ____ the assistants attended the briefing about the project.
e: The correlative conjunction is “both…and.”

q: Before leaving the auditorium with the project, Hamza advised, “Take an umbrella ____ it rains.”
e: “In case” introduces a precaution against a possible event.

q: After completing the schedule at the classroom, Hamza left early ____ the last bus could be caught on time.
e: “So that” introduces the purpose of leaving early.

q: The assignment assigned to Mariam at the auditorium was difficult; ____, the team completed it on time.
e: “Nevertheless” is a conjunctive adverb showing contrast despite the preceding fact.

q: At the station, Raza stayed late ____ the proposal could be completed.
e: “So that” introduces purpose or intended result.

q: ____ it was raining outside the auditorium, the match described in Ali's presentation continued.
e: “Although” introduces a concessive finite clause.
